raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Luxor from Arabic al-Uqsur (الأقصر) via Coptic p-šlol, from Latin castra; but here read as Latin lux + -or",
    "reading": "Light-bearer; the place or agent that carries light, from Latin lux (light) and -or (state/agent suffix)",
    "languages": ["la", "ar", "cop"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary, entry 'Luxor' (etymology)",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Lu + xor; lu (French 'lu' = read, past participle) + xor (exclusive OR in logic)",
    "reading": "That which is read exclusively; a secret text that yields one meaning only when properly decoded",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Luxor ~ lux or (Latin 'light' + French 'gold') ~ l'usure (French 'usury')",
    "reading": "Light of gold, but also usury — the gleam of wealth that corrodes; a double-edged brilliance",
    "languages": ["la", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Luxor → xulor → x + ulor; ulor (Latin) = to howl, wail; x = unknown",
    "reading": "The unknown howl; a cry from a place not yet named, the sound of light in pain",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L-U-X-O-R → Lumen, Umbra, Xenos, Ordo, Rerum (Latin: light, shadow, stranger, order, of things)",
    "reading": "Light, shadow, stranger, order, of things — a cosmic sequence of opposites and hidden order",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L (el = God in Hebrew) + U (you) + X (cross/unknown) + O (circle/zero) + R (res = thing)",
    "reading": "God in you, the unknown cross, the zero of matter — a hieroglyph of divine incarnation",
    "languages": ["he", "en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "L=12, U=21, X=24, O=15, R=18 → sum 90; 90 = 9×10, 9 = completion, 10 = sephiroth",
    "reading": "Ninety: completion of the ten spheres — the full circuit of creation, a closed loop of light",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Lux + or; lux (Latin light) + or (French 'gold' in 'or') → light-gold",
    "reading": "Light that is also gold — alchemical gold, the philosopher's stone as radiant matter",
    "languages": ["la", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Luxor ~ look-sore (English) ~ lucks-or (English) ~ l'axe d'or (French 'axis of gold')",
    "reading": "To look sorely at the golden axis — a vision that hurts, the blinding truth of the centre",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Luxor from Latin 'lūx' (light) + suffix '-or' (agent noun) — cf. 'splendor', 'fulgor'",
    "reading": "A shining one; that which emits light — a nominalised verb of illumination",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, A Latin Dictionary (entry 'lux')",
    "confidence": 0.8
  }
]
